logline: Inside the opulent Ashbury estate, the treacherous Rupert and Catherine plot to seize the ducal title as the Dowager Duchess slowly withers, while in an icy barn, Juliana defiantly prepares remedies to save the fever-stricken villagers.
continuity_notes: Follows Episode 19's night in the barn; as Alexander begins his clandestine fight to reclaim his birthright, Juliana tends to the suffering village while Rupert and Catherine celebrate their anticipated ascension to the ducal throne.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Passionate, Unflinching)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: The chapel is gone, Seamus. I am the only healer these people have left.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Unyielding)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I keep the basket.

dialogue_segments.label: SEAMUS (Saddened, Heartbroken)
dialogue_segments.speaker: SEAMUS
dialogue_segments.text: They have reduced you to a peasant.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Proud, Indomitable)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: They have reduced me to myself.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Steely)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: And I am not finished.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Cruel, Callous)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Let the peasants rot in their barns.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Mocking, Spiteful)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Let them pray to their weeds.

dialogue_segments.label: RUPERT (Intimate, Reassuring)
dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: You have no rival here, Catherine.

dialogue_segments.label: RUPERT (Fawning)
dialogue_segments.speaker: RUPERT
dialogue_segments.text: No one to stand in your way.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Triumphant, Greedy)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Once the old Duchess is gone...

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Possessive)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: ...Ashbury will finally belong to us.

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Cold, Ruthless)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: This house will only bow to me.

action_segments.text: Catherine's gloved hand sets her fine porcelain teacup down onto the silver tray with a delicate clatter.

action_segments.text: Catherine rises from her chair in one regal motion and glides toward the towering window overlooking the vast estate grounds.
